requirements.text: Strong professional experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem
Hands-on experience with .NET Framework, including maintenance and enhancement of legacy applications
.NET 8+ and ASP.NET Core for modern backend development
Proven experience designing and building RESTful APIs
Strong knowledge of SQL Server, relational database design and query optimization
Software architecture principles, design patterns and clean code
Experience with automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit or MSTest
Experience using Git in collaborative development environments
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes
Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application architectures
Experience working in agile development environments

resumes.text:
Daniel Roth
Senior C# Developer, Hamburg

Senior .NET developer with eight years of experience building backend services in C#. Strong across legacy .NET Framework maintenance and modern .NET 8 with ASP.NET Core. Focused on clean code, well-tested services and reliable deployment. Works in agile Scrum teams. Fluent English, C1 certified.

- Separated domain logic from infrastructure using repository and strategy approaches, which made the core pricing rules easy to test.
- Covered core code with xUnit tests and used Git branches with pull request reviews for every change.
- Built an automated build and release pipeline that brought deploy time down from 2 hours to 15 minutes.
- Hosted the services on AWS (EC2 and S3) and managed the cloud setup.
- Worked in agile Scrum teams with two-week sprints.

Developer, Elbe Commerce AG, Hamburg (2016 to 2021)
- Maintained an ASP.NET WebForms ordering system on .NET Framework 4.7, adding features and fixing bugs.
- Built C# console tools for nightly data imports.

Education
B.Sc. Computer Science, HAW Hamburg, 2015

Skills
C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, .NET Framework, SQL Server, RESTful APIs, xUnit, Git

Languages
English: C1 certified (Cambridge Advanced).
